definition: OpenNN (Open Neural Networks Library) is a software library written in the C++ programming language which implements neural networks, a main area of deep learning research.
details: The library is open-source, licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License.

explainer.lead: OpenNN is an open-source C++ library implementing neural networks, a core area of deep learning research. It gives C++ developers a way to build and train neural networks without a higher-level framework.

tiers.eli5: It is a free toolbox, written in a language called C++, for building and training simple brain-inspired programs.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers link OpenNN into C++ applications to implement and train neural networks directly. Because it is a library rather than an end-to-end platform, users supply their own data handling and deployment plumbing.
tiers.paperLevel: It is a software library for neural networks distributed under the GNU Lesser General Public License; no architecture or accuracy claims are specified.

explainer.example: A team adds OpenNN to a C++ project, defines a network, and trains it on their dataset within the same build.
